report: # 1. Executive Diagnosis + Summary of Reason IIMK_PCPF_10 performed **well against plan but poorly against history**: all four planned outcome metrics exceeded target, while applications, enrollments, conversion rates, and observed-spend efficiency generally deteriorated versus all three selected prior batches. - Leads reached **4,260 vs 2,455 planned (173.5%)**, applications **64 vs 40 (160.0%)**, and enrollments **52 vs 35 (148.6%)**. - Actual GSV was **₹12.48M vs ₹8.05M planned (155.0%)**, a positive variance of **₹4.43M**. - Observed spend was **₹2.73M vs ₹1.87M planned**, an overrun of **₹0.86M or 46.3%**. - Applications were **25.6%–34.7% below** the three prior batches, while enrollments were **27.8%–37.3% below**. - L2A fell to **1.50%**, down **0.12–0.91 pp**, and W2A fell to **4.73%**, down **1.07–1.87 pp**, versus prior batches. - Observed-spend CAC increased to **₹52,486**, **53.3%–92.8% higher** than the selected historical batches. ## Where it went wrong 1. **Plan attainment was strong, but required materially more spend.** Leads, applications, enrollments, and GSV achieved **173.5%, 160.0%, 148.6%, and 155.0%** of plan respectively, while observed spend reached **146.3% of budget**. **Plan attainment rating: Good — 100.0%**, based on the average of capped attainment for **leads, applications, enrollments, and GSV**; each was capped at 100% for scoring. 2. **Commercial volumes declined versus history despite exceeding the current plan.** Applications were **64**, versus **88 (-27.3%)** in IIMK_PCPF_09, **86 (-25.6%)** in IIMK_PCPF_08, and **98 (-34.7%)** in IIMK_PCPF_07. Enrollments were **52**, down **27.8%, 31.6%, and 37.3%** respectively. 3. **The principal funnel leakage was before application.** L2A was **1.50%**, below IIMK_PCPF_09 by **0.41 pp**, IIMK_PCPF_08 by **0.12 pp**, and IIMK_PCPF_07 by **0.91 pp**. W2A was also lower by **1.16 pp, 1.07 pp, and 1.87 pp**, indicating weaker warm-lead-to-application progression; evidence does not establish the underlying cause. 4. **Observed acquisition efficiency deteriorated.** CPL rose to **₹641**, up **19.7% vs PCPF_09, 33.2% vs PCPF_08, and 15.2% vs PCPF_07**. CAC rose to **₹52,486**, up **53.3%, 56.1%, and 92.8%**, respectively; these are observed-spend metrics and may be affected by incomplete spend coverage. 5. **Historical comparison rating: Poor.** Across leads, applications, enrollments, L2W, L2A, L2E, W2A, A2E, CPL, and CAC, the direction-aware results were: - vs IIMK_PCPF_09: **0 improved / 10 declined / 0 unchanged** - vs IIMK_PCPF_08: **1 improved / 9 declined / 0 unchanged** - vs IIMK_PCPF_07: **1 improved / 9 declined / 0 unchanged** - Aggregate: **2 improved / 28 declined / 0 unchanged**; more than half deteriorated. # 2. The largest group, **07–12**, handled **1,712 leads** but ranked fourth, making it operationally material; these are associations and do not establish advisor-driven causation. Lower tenure-month values represent **more experienced advisors**, while higher values represent **less experienced advisors**. On this scale, the most experienced reported group ranked highest and the least experienced group ranked lowest, but the evidence cannot determine whether experience caused the difference. # 6. Prioritized actions 1. **Address Facebook funnel leakage before adding volume.** Review targeting, lead qualification, and follow-up for its **2,158 leads**, **17.15% L2W**, **1.62% W2A**, and two enrollments; the data identify the weak funnel but do not establish its cause. 2. **Recover warm-lead-to-application conversion.** Audit contact cadence and application handoffs across major sources because total W2A declined to **4.73%**, below every selected prior batch. 3. **Validate spend completeness and budget reconciliation.** Finance and Marketing should reconcile the **₹2.73M observed spend** against the **₹1.87M budget** and confirm whether missing source-level spend affects source CPL/CAC conclusions. 4. **Rebalance only after controlled validation.** Test whether website-like and referral-like conversion can scale, while recognizing their smaller lead bases and unavailable spend; compare incremental enrollments and observed CAC before reallocating budget. 5. **Review advisor capacity and routing.** Examine the high-volume **07–12** group and the lower-scoring **24+** group for workload, source mix, and process differences. Validate these factors operationally rather than attributing performance to tenure alone.
